name: directions_annot_clear_merged
title: R3 mean-difference steering directions, merged corpus (conf=clear)
description: 96 unit directions dir_<class>_L<layer> = mean(controls) - mean(onsets), from 231 captures across xsub+b2. Supersedes directions_annot_clear.npz (xsub-only) as the constant-lambda baseline of TERMINAL_FORK_COMPUTE constraint 7. Gated by merged probe AUROC.
caveats: Observational origin; fixed-direction baseline only — a learned controller must beat it.
